- **Links2Care EarlyON:** 
The programs are free for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers, in Halton Hills.
 
They're offered in person, drop-in, registered and online.
 I left out `when` because I couldn't open the current fall schedule. Their page says the current schedule is further down it. Some of their programs need registration, and the summer schedule used Eventbrite or in-person sign-up, so check the current schedule before going.
- **Kids & Me:** 
It's a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program for families with babies or children up to 6 years of age.
 
No registration is required.
 The Monday 10:00–11:30 slot at the Acton Community Hub is what the Region's page lists for Halton Hills. I read it from a search snippet that cut off partway, so I haven't seen the full listing.

I left out Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's preschool drop-in because it isn't free. 
It costs $15 for one parent and up to 4 children.
